response.query: What are the top innovative trends in Health & Medical Sciences related to multi-task AI, advanced imaging, radiomics, harmonization, and regulatory practices for research and clinical deployment?

results.title: Advancing Medical Imaging Research Through ...
results.content: | Advantages | ♦ Simplifies the integration of clinical and imaging data through structured database formats ♦ Promotes semantic standardization of radiology imaging data, supporting the clarity and consistency of metadata ♦ Demonstrates feasibility with real-world data by deidentifying and converting radiology data into R-CDM | ♦ Provides a universal framework for DICOM data, improving scalability and inclusivity ♦ Facilitates federated analysis with privacy and provenance, ensuring reproducible AI validation across institutions ♦ Bridges imaging and clinical data gaps, improving analysis capabilities, including biomarker exploration and longitudinal study of imaging features. BIDS, Brain Imaging Data Structure; CHAIMELEON, Not an acronym but a project name; CT, computed tomography; DICOM, Digital Imaging and Communications in Medicine; EHR, electronic health record; _ICD-10_, _International Classification of Diseases, 10th Revision_; LOINC, Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes; MAIDA, Medical AI Data for All; MR, magnetic resonance; NCI, National Cancer Institute; NCIt, National Cancer Institute Thesaurus; NIfTI, Neuroimaging Informatics Technology Initiative; OMOP CDM, Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership Common Data Model; PACS, Picture Archiving and Communication System; PET/CT, positron emission tomography/computed tomography; RTSS, radiation therapy structure set; SEG, segmentation; SMI, Scottish Medical Imaging; SNOMED, Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine–Clinical Terms; SR, structured report; W3C PROV, World Wide Web Consortium Provenance.
